outer(value) => request.security("BINANCE:BTCUSDT", "1D", request.security("BINANCE:BTCUSDT", "1D", lib.pick(value) + lib.pick(int(7)), lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on), lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)

plot(dVolume, title="D_VOLUME")

plot(nTime, title="N_TIME")
plot(nTimeClose, title="N_TIME_CLOSE")
plot(nOpen, title="N_OPEN")
plot(nHigh, title="N_HIGH")
plot(nLow, title="N_LOW")
plot(nClose, title="N_CLOSE")
plot(nVolume, title="N_VOLUME")
plot(time, title="CHART_TIME")
plot(time_close, title="CHART_TIME_CLOSE")
plot(open, title="CHART_OPEN")
plot(high, title="CHART_HIGH")
plot(low, title="CHART_LOW")
plot(close, title="CHART_CLOSE")
plot(volume, title="CHART_VOLUME")
plot(barstate.isconfirmed ? 1 : 0, title="CHART_CONFIRMED")
plot(timenow, title="CAPTURE_CLOCK_MS")
